title: POST /device-work/extraction/{leaseId}/outcome body (lld.md#text-extraction-and-ocr)
description: The phone gives a file back. `unavailable` returns it to the queue (the recognizer or the file could not be used now); `encrypted` and `unsupported` end it as unsupported with that detail; `failed` ends it as failed with `parser_error`. The original attachment stays downloadable in every case.
